title: Grateful Dead Live at Giants Stadium on 1989-07-09
lineage: Master DAT @ 48kHz > Panasonic SV3700  > 48kHz 16bit Wav > Sample Manager > 44.1kHz 24bit Wav > Wavelab 8.5 / Izotope Ozone 6.1 / MBit+ Dither > 44.1kHz 16bit wav; Recorded, Transferred and Digitally Mastered by Dan Tepper
source: Source: AKG 414-BTL (cardioid X-Y) > Neuman BS945i > Technics SVMD1 DAT;

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality recording that captures a wild Bird Song, but the concert is actually a Dark Star Orchestra performance.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its excellent sound, with listeners noting a particularly fiery Bird Song. However, the show isn’t an original Grateful Dead gig—it’s a 2006 Dark Star Orchestra set that fooled some fans, leading to mixed reactions overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive remarks about the audio quality and a standout Bird Song are offset by confusion over the source (DSO vs. Dead) and one outright negative comment, yielding an overall moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer calls it "excellent recording"; no specific technical flaws are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure or pacing were provided.
